scope: All ramp/anomaly/temperature/failure outputs on the TEST window
statement: These files list timestamps flagged by simple heuristics (thresholds on power deltas, z-scores, temperature limits, repeated stops). They are NOT confirmed fault/event forecasts; each flag requires operator verification against O&M logs before being treated as an event.
reviewer_note: P1-05: renamed from 'fault forecast' to heuristic screening
